g.title: j192171366
g.text: Nothing? You could set a new high score on Caliber Chicks?

g.title: j2236208749
g.text: You could work on your Fables and Frontiers expansion campaign?

g.title: j3929238520
g.text: it's already over a hundred pages

g.title: j3830949909
g.text: and we're all out of pineapple

g.title: j1031826483
g.text: i have enough campaign to get us through the next five loops...

g.title: j54618958
g.text: but that's not how loops work you forget everything when the loop is over and i have to rewrite the campaign again

g.title: j2076322124
g.text: i already hung out with myself

g.title: j968547721
g.text: Wait? Didn't Arthur ask you to audit the inventory??

g.title: j3993956912
g.text: i'm CHOOSING to DEFER arthur's inventory audit to a later date

g.title: j4259785018
g.text: what if this is the best one and nobody gets to finish it because it's too long

g.title: j3166026168
g.text: gonna need to take a rain-check on that one

g.title: j3393753160
g.text: Maybe you should just do it?

g.title: j1673485038
g.text: Do that you won't be bored any more.

g.title: j2222362312
g.text: and then in the next loop my new one sucks and everyone in that loop hates it

g.title: j2175600069
g.text: maybe it's none of your business

g.title: j2365649823
g.text: that's literally the most boring thing i could possibly do. nothing, and i mean nothing is more boring than the thing i need to be doing

g.title: j1423340075
g.text: then we loop again and nobody can remember that they hated the campaign in the last loop, but there's some subtle imprint on the fabric of spacetime where they intrinsically know my campaign bored them in a previous loop. so they never want to play it again in any loop, ever

g.title: j3268140176
g.text: You'll be done in, like, two minutes.

g.title: j2221955570
g.text: I've seen you do that job in no time at all?

g.title: j2969312809
g.text: i don't want to work on that

g.title: j2771982362
g.text: except i can't just do it

g.title: j2289363923
g.text: Do it and it'll be done.

g.title: j1284547299
g.text: is that a butterfly??? gotta go byyyyyyeeee

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be AmirRank6Convo3.
